title: [BUG] Python EpochStore.boot_epoch cold-boot fallback is fixed 128, not random uniform [128,255]
description: Req R-02-064 (spec 02-physical-link.md 4.4): when no persisted epoch is available implementations MUST initialize epoch to a random value uniformly distributed in [128,255]. DIVERGENT: python/src/lichen/link/epoch_store.py:48-57 boot_epoch() returns FIXED 128 on cold boot (test_epoch_store.py:11 test_cold_boot_starts_at_128 pins it). The LinkLayer default field is conformant (link_layer.py:196 secrets.randbelow(128)+128) and C is conformant (link_ctx.c:237 128 + (rand_byte & 0x7F)); Rust is a contract (Stack::new asserts >=128) validated by epoch_rollover.json cold_boot_epoch_range. Fix: randomize boot_epoch fallback in [128,255] (secrets module already used elsewhere) and update the pinning test.
